Trump's NATO Summit Interactions and Criticisms Detailed

During a NATO summit, former U.S. President Donald Trump expressed frustration with NATO allies over defense spending and engaged in diplomatic exchanges with Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni. He also made comments regarding peace progress and the Ukraine conflict, while facing criticism for his disruptive approach to international relations.
